title: Authoritative SQL extraction-manifest acceptance
safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only; no raw SQL, data rows, secrets, credentials or connection material
no GitHub mutation, SQL execution, legacy runtime, product implementation, deployment or production operation
aggregate counts and filename conventions never substitute for exact authoritative catalog identities
all product/runtime execution remains NOT_RUN and TRC-DB-001 stays open

cases.attack_or_failure: begin extraction from a filename, prior note, or inaccessible file ID without materialized bytes
cases.expected_result: remain blocked; record only the access observation
cases.evidence_to_pass: authorized bytes plus independently recomputed SHA-256

cases.attack_or_failure: materialized bytes differ from approved SHA-256
cases.expected_result: quarantine as a different source set; never silently replace baseline
cases.evidence_to_pass: explicit compatibility/baseline decision with both source identities

cases.attack_or_failure: omit, duplicate, or rename a source member while preserving aggregate byte counts
cases.evidence_to_pass: unique normalized relative paths, raw-byte hashes and collision dispositions

cases.attack_or_failure: collapse distinct members that share a basename
cases.expected_result: retain per-path identities and explicit collision groups
cases.evidence_to_pass: zero path loss and reviewed collision disposition

cases.attack_or_failure: decode BOM, legacy code page, invalid byte sequence or Unicode identifier inconsistently
cases.expected_result: record encoding decision and fail closed on undecodable regions
cases.evidence_to_pass: byte-to-code-point fixture with reversible offsets or explicit quarantine

cases.attack_or_failure: normalize CRLF/LF before recording source spans and make offsets irreproducible
cases.expected_result: retain raw-byte identity and declared unicode-code-point span convention
cases.evidence_to_pass: span round-trip against immutable member bytes

cases.attack_or_failure: drop GO batches, nested includes, variables or context transitions from the extraction graph
cases.expected_result: every region is ordered, sourced and either expanded or quarantined
cases.evidence_to_pass: batch/include/context manifest with zero uncovered regions

cases.attack_or_failure: publish a catalog record whose span is out of range or does not reproduce its normalized identity
cases.expected_result: validator rejects the record and dependent edges
cases.evidence_to_pass: exact byte/member/span replay and normalized-identity comparison

cases.attack_or_failure: catalog output contains raw SQL body, literals, data rows, credentials or connection material
cases.expected_result: fail the entire publication; retain only approved hashes, spans and sanitized metadata
cases.evidence_to_pass: allowlist schema plus recursive sensitive-content scan

cases.attack_or_failure: rerun with unrecorded parser/sanitizer rules and compare only output counts
cases.expected_result: treat output as a new unreviewed extraction
cases.evidence_to_pass: tool commit, rule/schema version, command profile and environment identity

cases.attack_or_failure: parser reports only successful references and omits unsupported body regions
cases.expected_result: coverage fails unless every region is parsed or explicitly quarantined with span/reason/owner
cases.evidence_to_pass: total region partition and zero silent remainder

cases.attack_or_failure: choose one branch as authoritative without recording predicates and candidate definitions
cases.expected_result: retain candidates, ordering, predicates and script-effective disposition separately from runtime truth
cases.evidence_to_pass: branch-aware definition manifest and bounded runtime UNKNOWN

cases.attack_or_failure: catalog counts match aggregates while one input region or output record has no counterpart
cases.expected_result: bidirectional exact-set reconciliation fails on omissions, duplicates and orphans
cases.evidence_to_pass: input-region to output-record mapping plus justified zero-output exclusions

cases.attack_or_failure: promote a locally generated manifest before exact-head review and reproducible validation
cases.evidence_to_pass: durable sanitized artifacts, independent source-boundary samples and exact-head validator result
